artboards.title: One Thing at a Time — mobile
One Thing at a Time — desktop

annotations.text:
MOBILE — where the stepped flow actually belongs.
Every step fits one screen; nothing scrolls. The goods and the running total sit pinned under the header and never leave. What is already settled folds to one line with a Change link — desktop can afford two rows, a phone cannot. One action, always the bottom of the screen.

DESKTOP — the layout the live checkout already has at lg: but never had a design.
Three steps, one open at a time. Finished steps fold to an editable line; steps not reached sit greyed below, so the column reads as a sequence rather than an empty half-page. The payment method opens in place.
Colour comes from the theme chip — the 22 real themes in lib/emakola/themes. Checkout reads --theme-primary twice, as --color-store-accent and as --color-cta-dark. Telco marks never follow the theme. Cash and card never borrow the mobile-money screen: own picture, own words, no USSD code.
Still open: the region list is words plus a price. A buyer who cannot read "Ashanti" cannot pick it.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for the record, 2026-08-29. One Thing at a Time won.
Picture First demoted words to captions under pictures; Ask Less cut the form to two fields and moved delivery to a seller phone call.
